note: Which model fills `harm` for each area. Set by the shipping rule in docs/PREREGISTRATION.md, using the revised held-out check C3r adopted by Mahabu on 14 Nov 2026 (docs/DECISIONS.md, decision 30). Both the original and the revised verdicts are published in meta.json.

cordoba.reason: Detection curve. Passes C0, C1, C1b, C2, C3r, C4 and C8. Fails the original held-out check C3 (0.207 against 0.15); the team adopted the revised check C3r, which it passes (0.072 against 0.10). Both verdicts are shown.

punjab-haryana.reason: Hard floor. The detection curve fails C8 here (its midpoint is too uncertain), so the rule moves to the hard floor, which passes C0, C1, C1b, C2, C3r and C4. Fails the original C3 (0.291). Both verdicts are shown.

chilecito.reason: Case-study area with too few fires to calibrate. Uses Cordoba's detection curve and constants, and Cordoba's model. Its own checks are shown and several fail because so few fires occur there.

karnataka-south.reason: Shipping rule: no model passes the held-out checks here (C3 and C3r: in 2018-2019 Aqua saw 20 to 32 percent more than any harmonized version), so the constant-ratio fallback ships. The detection curve passed C0, C1, C1b, C2, C4 and C8; the fallback fails C2 (-0.112). Region added after the start (decision 36); not pre-registered.
